{"purpose":"Get gross sales, refunds, and net sales by month and customer segment for August and September 2026","sql":"WITH monthly_orders AS (
  SELECT
    strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) AS month,
    c.segment,
    SUM(o.amount_cents) AS gross_sales_cents

  JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE order_date >= '2026-08-01' AND order_date < '2026-10-01'
  GROUP BY month, c.segment
),
monthly_refunds AS (
  SELECT
    strftime('%Y-%m', r.refund_date) AS month,
    c.segment,
    SUM(r.amount_cents) AS refunds_cents

  JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE r.refund_date >= '2026-08-01' AND r.refund_date < '2026-10-01'
  GROUP BY month, c.segment
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(o.month, r.month) AS month,
  COALESCE(o.segment, r.segment) AS segment,
